title: Local extension of maps between canonical finite free sheaves
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], r and s natural numbers, y a point of Y, and F_r and F_s the canonical finite free structure sheaves [def-weil-pbc-free-module] on ULift (Fin r) and ULift (Fin s). Given t: T(F_r) → T(F_s), where T is ordinary module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] along Y.fromSpecStalk y, there is an open neighbourhood U of y and g: R_U(F_r) → R_U(F_s), where R_U is restriction, such that S_U(g) = E_U(F_r).hom ; t ; E_U(F_s).inv. Here S_U is pullback along U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y and E_U: R_U ⋙ S_U ≅ T is exactly the underlying module natural isomorphism used in [def-pc-stalk-restriction-complex-iso]: restriction-as-pullback followed by pullback composition and pullbackCongr for U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y ≫ U.ι = Y.fromSpecStalk y.

proof.text: Identify pullbacks of the two canonical free sheaves with free sheaves on Spec O_{Y,y}. The free universal property and affine global-section identification turn t into a finite matrix of elements of O_{Y,y}. Represent each entry by a section near y and intersect the finitely many opens, keeping y in the intersection. Form the corresponding map on the restrictions. Compatibility of the chosen germs with restriction and the three comparison isomorphisms gives the displayed equality. Empty matrices give the zero map on Y.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_free_stalk_map
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (r s : ℕ) (y : Y)
    (t : (Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) ⟶
      (Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s)))) :
    ∃ (U : Y.Opens), ∃ (hyU : y ∈ U), ∃ (g :
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) ⟶
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s)))),
      let E := Functor.isoWhiskerRight (restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι)
          (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)) ≪≫
        pullbackComp (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU) U.ι ≪≫
        pullbackCongr (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι y hyU)
      (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map g =
        E.hom.app _ ≫ t ≫ E.inv.app _
